column_semantics: The schedule has a single Interest Rate column. For PIK-bearing rows, that column prints the total stated rate and either marks the entire rate as PIK or states that the printed rate includes a specified PIK component; the filing does not present separate cash and PIK rate columns.

rationale: The target-quarter schedule uses one Interest Rate column, not separate Cash and PIK columns. PIK is disclosed inside that same rate text: some rows print a total rate followed by '(incl ... PIK)', and fully PIK instruments print the PIK rate as the Interest Rate. This means the stated position-level interest rate is all-in, with the PIK component included in the printed rate rather than added on top.
